subject.title: [AI] fix(embedding): retry without dimensions and degrade non-local providers on persistent failure

question: After fixing the premature circuit state, should omitted or automatic non-local memory providers degrade to FTS-only after every persistent runtime embedding failure?
rationale: Current documentation establishes missing-auth fallback for automatic selection and failure fallback for local embeddings, but does not promise that all remote runtime failures become silent FTS-only operation.

options.title: Narrow to dimensions repair
options.body: Remove generalized non-local degradation and merge the adapter repair after fixing its circuit state and rebasing onto current main.

options.title: Expand automatic fallback
options.body: Keep generalized degradation only with explicit memory-owner approval, updated documentation, and focused required-versus-optional runtime failure tests.

recommendation.title: Narrow to dimensions repair
recommendation.body: Remove generalized non-local degradation and merge the adapter repair after fixing its circuit state and rebasing onto current main.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history across memory retry and fallback behavior and co-authored the current-main finite-attempt implementation.
